messages:
maya: Moving flats next weekend, clearing out a couple things. Free pickup in Mission. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/maya-stuff

Items:
- LG 34" ultrawide monitor (34WN80)  light marks on stand, works perfectly.
- Small rolling filing cabinet (2-drawer)  caster replaced last month.
- Blue Herman Miller seat cushion (memory foam)  barely used.
- Pair of Moma conference passes (expo day)  want them gone together.

Pickup window: Sat 9:00-11:30. DM to claim. No shipping.

ron: Interested in the monitor. Does it have USB-C?

maya: yes USB-C + DisplayPort + HDMI. 75Hz.

eden: I'll take the cabinet if no one else. Can pick at 10:15.

ops-bot: Reminder: do not post personal addresses publicly. Use DMs for exact meetup. :lock:

samir: Can i grab the cushion? will pay $10 for convenience.

maya: Samir, sure. Hold until 9:30 for you.

ron: i'll Venmo $20 for the monitor stand tweak (if that's ok).

maya: Sounds good. Monitor -> ron, cabinet -> eden, cushion -> samir, passes -> first DM to claim both. thanks! :smile:
